newsitem.title: FRANCE: French defence minister to Poland on Friday.
newsitem.headline: French defence minister to Poland on Friday.

text.p: French Defence Minister Charles Millon will discuss cooperation between the French and Polish air forces as well as between the two countries' aviation industries when he visits Warsaw on Friday, his office said.
"There will be discussions about defence industries, specifically about air defence and combat aircraft," spokesman Pierre Servent said about the one-day visit.
He added that exchanges between the armed forces of France and Poland would also be discussed.
